query: INSERT INTO levels( id, venue, chain, token_in, token_out, side, trigger_price_usd, amount, amount_decimals, slippage_bps, created_at ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, unixepoch()) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET venue = excluded.venue, chain = excluded.chain, token_in = excluded.token_in, token_out = excluded.token_out, side = excluded.side, trigger_price_usd = excluded.trigger_price_usd, amount = excluded.amount, amount_decimals = excluded.amount_decimals, slippage_bps = excluded.slippage_bps
